scope: Before inspecting row-level outcomes in this phase; documentation/schema inspection and prior phase release summaries are known. This is a prospective local analysis register, not an external time-stamped registration.
observation_level: Released calibrated SNANA flux photometry; not detector pixels or raw ADU images.
data_sets: DES-SN5YR tag 1.3 SMP DES, Foundation and LOWZ
DES-SN5YR acquired Dovekie commit c9a4fcafc4cbd19bd750dee47fc76194a45c181f photometry
Public all99+head ancillary table if locatable

tests.test: Hash source bytes and record pinned source provenance; verify gzip CRC and FITS structure. Compare same-named photometry across release versions bytewise before treating releases as separate observations.

Audit every HEAD and PHOT row: unique SNID per data version; 1-based inclusive PTROBS_MIN/MAX in bounds; NOBS equals span; nonoverlap; MJD=-777 delimiter follows each object; unowned nonsentinel rows and sentinel rows inside spans.
Report every field's nonfinite, blank and conventional sentinel counts (-9,-99,-999,-9999,-777); do not automatically equate legitimate negative flux, x1, colour or SFR with missingness.

For all observation rows audit finite MJD, flux, uncertainty; positive uncertainties; band, field and quality flag distributions; exact duplicate object/MJD/band and object/image/band observations. Report duplicates without silently deduplicating.

Report signed SNR and threshold counts, negative/zero flux, per-object/band cadence, time coverage and flux-error-derived 5sigma depth. Depth is a local error proxy, not an independently measured completeness limit.

Evaluate separately structural/basic flux eligibility and reconstructable release cuts: z and zerr, MW reddening, minimum epochs, two-band SNR, PSF and electron zero-point, rest-phase coverage. Published fitted PEAKMJD and SALT cuts may not be available for all objects; label partial cut reconstruction explicitly.

Join object headers to Hubble-sample membership, metadata, classifiers and all99 ancillary rows by validated IDs; report unmatched and duplicate join keys. Do not interpret absence from published cosmology as random selection.

Inspect SALT x0/x1/c parameter covariance availability and symmetry/PSD; report rounding/zero off-diagonals and distinguish covariance missingness from true zero correlations. Audit host mass/error, colour, sSFR, photo-z/spec-z and classifier probabilities.

Trace calibration, chromatic/DCR, flux uncertainty and simulation correction inputs from release configs. Acquire missing public files only with immutable source URL/version/checksum; do not claim a complete end-to-end selection likelihood from detected objects alone.

reporting_rules: Keep failures and missing fields visible
No exclusions chosen from Hubble residual or acceleration outcomes
No inference of raw detector-level calibration from already calibrated photometry
No new cosmology significance in this audit
timestamp_note: Filesystem creation-write time; initial hand-entered timestamp corrected to actual UTC before running audit.
